description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-TYPE: For FC groups 1 (Currency maximum, 0.0001, -0.0001), 2 (maximum, 1, -1) and 7 (0.0001, 0.0002, 0.0003), what result type and value (or error and call) do Sum(CDbl(c)), Sum(CDec(c)), Sum(CCur(c)), Sum(c * 1), Sum(c + 0) and Sum(c * 1.0) give, one statement per form and group? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.

args.text: SELECT Sum(CDbl(c)) AS s FROM FC WHERE g = 1
SELECT Sum(CDec(c)) AS s FROM FC WHERE g = 1
SELECT Sum(CCur(c)) AS s FROM FC WHERE g = 1
SELECT Sum(c * 1) AS s FROM FC WHERE g = 1
SELECT Sum(c + 0) AS s FROM FC WHERE g = 1
SELECT Sum(c * 1.0) AS s FROM FC WHERE g = 1
